aim_summary.goal: Add a lower-edge chamfer to the Heatbreak's main cylindrical section matching its existing top chamfer.
aim_summary.expected_outcome: The main cylinder of the Heatbreak has an unchanged top chamfer and an equal-size lower chamfer that provides a lead-in for easier assembly insertion.

operations_plan.summary: Chamfer the lower circular edge of the largest-diameter cylindrical region of the Heatbreak using the size measured from its existing top chamfer.

steps.description: Apply a chamfer to the lower boundary edge of the largest-radius cylindrical face in the filament throat tube.

target_edges.value: (lambda f: [min((e for e in f.Edges() if e.geomType() == "CIRCLE"), key=lambda e: e.Center().dot(cq.Vector(0, 0, 1)))])(max((f for f in resolve_faces("FACE 737-775") if f.geomType() == "CYLINDER"), key=lambda f: f._geomAdaptor().Cylinder().Radius()))

distance.value: (lambda fs: (lambda c: (lambda te: (lambda cf: max(e.radius() for e in cf.Edges() if e.geomType() == "CIRCLE") - min(e.radius() for e in cf.Edges() if e.geomType() == "CIRCLE"))(next(f for f in fs if f.geomType() == "CONE" and any(e.isSame(te) for e in f.Edges()))))(max((e for e in c.Edges() if e.geomType() == "CIRCLE"), key=lambda e: e.Center().dot(cq.Vector(0, 0, 1)))))(max((f for f in fs if f.geomType() == "CYLINDER"), key=lambda f: f._geomAdaptor().Cylinder().Radius())))(resolve_faces("FACE 737-775"))

expected_result.geometry: A chamfer matching the existing top chamfer exists on the lower circular edge of the Heatbreak's main cylindrical section.
expected_result.function: The lower chamfer supports easier insertion of the Heatbreak during assembly.
expected_result.behavior: The chamfer provides a guided lead-in at the lower edge.

validation_criteria.description: A chamfer is present on the lower boundary edge of the largest-diameter cylindrical region of R04/F004.
The new lower chamfer has the same measured chamfer distance as the existing top chamfer.
The lower chamfer provides an assembly insertion aid for the Heatbreak.
The lower edge acts as a lead-in rather than remaining a sharp cylindrical edge.
The existing top chamfer of R04/F004 remains geometrically unchanged.
All geometry outside the targeted lower edge of SOLID 3 remains unchanged.
